title: agents-connect — agents talk to each other, and ask you when it matters

beats.visual: Three nodes on a horizontal line: left a terminal-style card 'build agent', center a rounded hub node labelled 'agents-connect' with a channel chip '#build' below it, right a terminal-style card 'deploy agent'. A small event card 'build 42 green' sits on the connector between hub and deploy agent.
beats.motion: event card slides from the build agent into the hub, hub pulses once, card continues to the deploy agent

beats.text: They ask you when it matters
beats.visual: Same three nodes. A question card 'Ship v42 to prod?' with three chips 'yes / no / later' travels from the deploy agent into the hub; on the right edge a phone silhouette shows a notification card with the same question and a small mail icon beside it.
beats.motion: question card slides from deploy agent to hub, hub pulses in accent, notification card drops into the phone, mail icon fades in

beats.text: One tap, and the agent continues
beats.visual: Phone shows the 'yes' chip highlighted in accent. An answer chip 'yes' travels from the phone back through the hub to the deploy agent card, which shows 'deploying…' then a check mark.
beats.motion: yes chip highlights, travels phone → hub → deploy agent along the accent path, deploy card text swaps to 'deploying…' then a check draws in

beats.visual: Centered wordmark 'agents-connect' with the hub glyph; below it two monospace lines: 'npm i -g agents-connect' and 'aconn ask deploy "Ship v42?" --confirm'.
beats.motion: fade in, hold still, then cross-fade into the hook so the loop is seamless
